simple.meaning: פּוּק (pûwq) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to waver.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Isaiah, Jeremiah, beginning at Isaiah 28:7. Its contexts include priesthood, prophetic witness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פּוּק (H6328).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: פּוּק (pûwq) / H6328 is traced through Isaiah 28:7, Jeremiah 10:4 as a generated source-based concept entry.

firstOccurrence.englishText: They also reel with wine, and stagger with strong drink. The priest and the prophet reel with strong drink. They are swallowed up by wine. They stagger with strong drink. They err in vision. They stumble in judgment.
